reviewMethod: Antigravity drafts separately reviewed against complete archived version bodies and source notes; source discrepancies retained explicitly.

headings.title: Criteria for designation as domestic surplus lines insurer
headings.reviewNote: Read sub 1 (4 subdivisions): deems a Missouri-domiciled nonadmitted insurer a domestic surplus lines insurer if it has >=$20M policyholder surplus, out-of-state eligibility, a board resolution, and director written approval.

headings.title: Nonadmitted status under federal 2010 act
headings.reviewNote: Read sub 2: considers a domestic surplus lines insurer a nonadmitted insurer for Missouri risks under 15 U.S.C. § 8201 (source text cites 'Nonadmitted and Reinsurance Act of 2010', omitting 'Reform').

headings.title: Authority to write eligible surplus lines insurance
headings.reviewNote: Read sub 3: deems a domestic surplus lines insurer eligible to write any kind of insurance that a non-domiciled nonadmitted insurer is eligible to write. Tightened wording.

headings.title: Taxation of policies issued by domestic surplus lines insurers
headings.reviewNote: Read sub 4: subjects policies issued in Missouri to surplus lines taxes including § 384.059 premium tax, and exempts them from admitted insurer taxes including § 148.320.

headings.title: Inapplicability of state guaranty associations
headings.reviewNote: Read sub 5: excludes domestic surplus lines policies from Missouri property and casualty (spelled 'guarantee' in source) and life and health guaranty association acts.

headings.title: Applicability of general financial and solvency requirements
headings.reviewNote: Read sub 6: applies domestic admitted insurer financial and solvency requirements in chapters 374, 375, 379, and 382 unless specifically exempted.

headings.title: Exemption from form, rate, and nonrenewal regulations
headings.reviewNote: Read sub 7: exempts domestic surplus lines insurers from statutory rating plans, policy forms, cancellation/nonrenewal, and premium requirements to the same extent as foreign nonadmitted insurers.

headings.title: Rulemaking authority of director
headings.reviewNote: Read sub 8: permits director to promulgate and amend rules under § 374.045 relating to domestic surplus lines insurers.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently verified all 8 subsections and source notes (L. 2014 H.B. 1361). Refined subs 2 and 3 titles (noting sub 2 cites 'Nonadmitted and Reinsurance Act of 2010' without 'Reform') and corrected sub 4 note (§ 148.320 admitted insurer tax, not corporate tax).

headings.title: Prerequisites for placing surplus lines coverage with nonadmitted insurer
headings.reviewNote: Read sub 1 (2 subdivisions): prohibits placement unless insurer is authorized in domicile and either has >=$15M/state-minimum capital and surplus (or director acceptability finding with $4.5M floor) or appears on director's semiannual list or NAIC IID quarterly alien list.

headings.title: Exempt commercial purchaser due diligence search exemption
headings.reviewNote: Read sub 2 (2 subdivisions): exempts licensee from due diligence search for an exempt commercial purchaser after admitted-market disclosure and written purchaser request; source text reads 'obtained from nonadmitted insurers' verbatim.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently verified both subsections and source notes (L. 1987 H.B. 700 § 3 through A.L. 2014 H.B. 1361). Confirmed both draft titles; corrected sub 1 note (director semiannual list/NAIC IID alien list and $4.5M floor, not foreign trust) and noted verbatim 'nonadmitted insurers' wording in sub 2.

headings.title: Grounds for director declaration of insurer ineligibility
headings.reviewNote: Read sub 1 (4 subdivisions): permits director to declare an eligible surplus lines insurer ineligible for unsound financial condition, loss of § 384.021 eligibility, willful violation of Missouri law, or failure to pay just losses promptly.

headings.title: Publication of ineligibility declaration
headings.reviewNote: Read sub 2: requires director to promptly publish notice of all ineligibility declarations in any public electronic format.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently verified both subsections and source notes (L. 1987 H.B. 700 § 5, A.L. 2009 H.B. 577). Confirmed both draft titles for permissive director ineligibility declarations and prompt public electronic publication.

headings.title: Formation and purposes of advisory surplus lines organization
headings.reviewNote: Read sub 1 (4 subdivisions): permits surplus lines licensees to form an advisory organization to encourage compliance, confidentially examine member coverages, communicate with admitted insurer organizations, and disseminate information. Replaced hallucinated draft.

headings.title: Required filings with director by advisory organization
headings.reviewNote: Read sub 2 (5 subdivisions): requires filing constitution/articles, bylaws/rules, current member list, resident agent for service, and an examination agreement with the director. Replaced hallucinated draft.

headings.title: Periodic examination, hearing rights, and violation orders
headings.reviewNote: Read sub 3: mandates director examination at least once every 3 years at organization's cost, oath examination of officers/records, 20-day hearing request on examination report, and permissive orders to discontinue §§ 384.011–384.071 violations. Replaced hallucinated draft.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently verified all 3 subsections and source notes (L. 1987 H.B. 700 § 8, effective 7-01-87). Replaced all 3 completely hallucinated draft titles (which described eligibility verification and policy advisory notices) with accurate headings for advisory surplus lines organizations.

headings.title: Evidence of insurance required upon placement
headings.reviewNote: Read sub 1: requires prompt delivery of policy or executed certificate/cover note/binder upon placement, detailing subject, coverages, limitations, premium/rate/taxes, insured/insurer names and risk proportions, and licensee name/number.

headings.title: Prohibition on issuing false or unauthorized evidence of insurance
headings.reviewNote: Read sub 2: bars licensee from issuing evidence of insurance or representing coverage by an eligible or § 384.023 nonadmitted insurer without insurer authority or regular-course confirmation.

headings.title: Substitute or endorsement required after material changes
headings.reviewNote: Read sub 3: requires prompt substitute or endorsement accurately showing current coverage and responsible insurers after any change in insurer identity, risk proportion, or material coverage terms. Fixed shifted draft.

headings.title: Delivery of replacement policy or complete certificate
headings.reviewNote: Read sub 4: requires delivering a copy of the policy (or complete certificate of insurance containing all agreements, conditions, exclusions, and endorsements) as soon as reasonably possible to replace prior evidence. Fixed shifted draft.

headings.title: Penalties for licensee noncompliance
headings.reviewNote: Read sub 5: subjects any surplus lines licensee who fails to comply with this section to the penalties hereinafter provided. Replaced hallucinated draft.

headings.title: Mandatory ten-point nonadmitted insurer disclosure legend
headings.reviewNote: Read sub 6: requires every evidence of insurance under §§ 384.011–384.071 to bear licensee's name and the verbatim 10-point type Missouri Surplus Lines / non-guaranty / unlicensed-insurer legend on its face or declaration page. Replaced inaccurate draft.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently verified all 6 subsections and source notes (L. 1987 H.B. 700 § 9, A.L. 1989 S.B. 250). Confirmed subs 1–2 and replaced shifted/hallucinated draft titles in subs 3–6 (material-change endorsements, replacement policy/certificate delivery, noncompliance penalties, and mandatory 10-point disclosure legend).

headings.title: Surplus lines license required to procure coverage
headings.reviewNote: Read sub 1: prohibits any insurance producer from procuring surplus lines insurance with a nonadmitted insurer without a current surplus lines license from the director. Replaced mismatched draft.

headings.title: License issuance criteria, fee, and examination
headings.reviewNote: Read sub 2 (3 subdivisions): requires director to issue license to qualified resident or nonresident P&C producer upon $100 initial fee, completed application, and passing exam (pre-July 1, 1987 holders deemed passed). Replaced mismatched draft.

headings.title: Biennial license renewal, fee, and termination
headings.reviewNote: Read sub 3: sets 2-year renewal term on licensee's birth date ($100 biennial fee), continuing until § 384.065 refusal/revocation/suspension, with termination if unpaid by birth date. Replaced hallucinated draft.

headings.title: Participation in national insurance producer database
headings.reviewNote: Read sub 4: requires director, beginning on or before July 1, 2012, to participate in NAIC's national insurance producer database (or equivalent uniform database) for licensure and renewal. Replaced hallucinated draft.

headings.title: Home state licensing requirement for nonadmitted insurance
headings.reviewNote: Read sub 5: requires a Missouri surplus lines license for selling, soliciting, or negotiating nonadmitted insurance only if Missouri is the insured's home state. Replaced hallucinated draft.

headings.title: Rulemaking authority regarding licensing standards
headings.reviewNote: Read sub 6: permits director to promulgate rules (including prorating periods for biennial birth-date renewals after Jan. 1, 2022); source footnote notes original rolls cite nonexistent § '375.045' where § 374.045 appears intended.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently verified all 6 subsections and source notes (L. 1987 H.B. 700 § 13 through A.L. 2021 S.B. 6; footnote flags original-rolls typo '375.045' in sub 6, noting § 374.045 appears intended). Replaced mismatched/hallucinated draft titles in subs 1–5 and verified sub 6 rulemaking.

headings.title: Annual report by directly procured surplus lines insureds
headings.reviewNote: Read sub 1 (6 subdivisions): requires Missouri home-state insureds or self-insurers procuring/renewing surplus lines coverage directly (not via a broker) to file an annual written report with director before March 2. Replaced hallucinated draft.

headings.title: Five percent gross premium tax and remittance
headings.reviewNote: Read sub 2: levies a 5% gross premium tax on sub 1 insureds/self-insurers, remitted to department of revenue before April 16, with revenue notifying director of collections. Replaced hallucinated draft.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently verified both subsections and source notes (L. 1987 H.B. 700 § 16 subsecs. 1–5 through A.L. 2011 S.B. 132, effective 7-07-11). Replaced both completely hallucinated draft titles (which described monthly broker reports) with accurate headings for directly procured insured reports and 5% gross premium tax.

headings.title: Annual sworn statement of gross and net premiums
headings.reviewNote: Read sub 1 (2 subdivisions): requires each surplus lines broker to file a sworn statement before March 2 reporting prior-year gross charges and net premiums (excluding taxes, less returned premiums) for Missouri home-state insureds. Replaced hallucinated draft.

headings.title: Quarterly sworn statements of gross and net premiums
headings.reviewNote: Read sub 2 (2 subdivisions): requires each surplus lines broker to file sworn quarterly statements within 45 days after each calendar quarter showing gross charges and net premiums for Missouri home-state insureds. Replaced hallucinated draft.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently verified both subsections and source notes (L. 1987 H.B. 700 § 16 subsec. 7 through A.L. 2011 S.B. 132, effective 7-07-11). Replaced both completely hallucinated draft titles (which described 5-year broker recordkeeping) with accurate headings for annual and quarterly sworn premium statements.

headings.title: Five percent surplus lines premium tax levy
headings.reviewNote: Read sub 1: imposes 5% tax on net premiums shown on § 384.057 annual report, payable before April 16, defines 'net premiums', and apportions airline, railroad, and motor carrier risks by Missouri revenue miles.

headings.title: Broker authority to collect premium tax from insured
headings.reviewNote: Read sub 2: permits surplus lines broker to collect an amount equal to the section's tax from the insured.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently verified both subsections and source notes (L. 1987 H.B. 700 § 17, A.L. 1989 S.B. 250). Confirmed both draft titles for the 5% surplus lines net premium tax (including carrier revenue-mile apportionment) and permissive broker tax collection from insureds.

headings.title: Home state rule for five percent premium tax allocation
headings.reviewNote: Read sub 1: provides that the 5% tax imposed by §§ 384.051 and 384.059 is levied upon and only upon the entire gross premium for nonadmitted or surplus lines policies where the insured's home state is Missouri.

headings.title: Home state jurisdictional limitation on licensing and regulation
headings.reviewNote: Read sub 2 (2 subdivisions): limits chapter's nonadmitted placement requirements and surplus lines broker licensing requirements solely to transactions where Missouri is the insured's home state.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently verified both subsections and source notes (L. 1989 S.B. 250, A.L. 2011 S.B. 132, effective 7-07-11). Confirmed both draft titles for Missouri home-state allocation of the 5% tax and home-state regulatory/licensing jurisdiction.

headings.title: Civil action to recover delinquent surplus lines taxes
headings.reviewNote: Read sub 1: makes unpaid taxes, penalties, or interest under §§ 384.011–384.071 recoverable in a suit brought by the director against the surplus lines licensee.

headings.title: Remittance of taxes to department of revenue
headings.reviewNote: Read sub 2: requires payment of chapter taxes, penalties, and interest to department of revenue (payable to director of revenue), which notifies director of sums collected.

headings.title: Classification under state tax collection statutes
headings.reviewNote: Read sub 3: classifies chapter taxes as taxes collected by the director of revenue within the meaning of § 139.031.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently verified all 3 subsections and source notes (L. 1987 H.B. 700 § 18 through A.L. 2009 H.B. 577). Confirmed all 3 draft titles for delinquent tax suits, remittance to department of revenue, and § 139.031 classification.

headings.title: Legal actions against surplus lines insurers and service of process
headings.reviewNote: Read sub 1: permits suing a surplus lines insurer on Missouri causes of action under §§ 375.256–375.266 and requires policies to state this section's substance and designate the director's mailing recipient.

headings.title: Constructive submission to jurisdiction by assuming risk
headings.reviewNote: Read sub 2: deems each surplus lines insurer assuming surplus lines insurance to have subjected itself to §§ 384.011–384.071.

headings.title: Cumulative nature of service of process remedies
headings.reviewNote: Read sub 3: states that section remedies are in addition to any other legal methods for service of process upon insurers.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently verified all 3 subsections and source notes (L. 1987 H.B. 700 § 20, effective 7-01-87). Confirmed all 3 draft titles for suits/service of process under §§ 375.256–375.266, constructive submission to §§ 384.011–384.071, and cumulative remedies.

headings.title: Administrative enforcement orders for surplus lines violations
headings.reviewNote: Read sub 1: permits director administrative orders under § 374.046 for §§ 384.011–384.071 violations (level three violation under § 374.049).

headings.title: Civil actions for surplus lines violations
headings.reviewNote: Read sub 2: permits director to maintain a civil action for relief under § 374.048 for §§ 384.011–384.071 violations (level three under § 374.049). Removed 'in circuit court' not stated in text.

headings.title: Misdemeanor penalty for unlawfully aiding nonadmitted insurer
headings.reviewNote: Read sub 3: provides that a surplus lines licensee representing or aiding a nonadmitted insurer in Missouri in violation of §§ 384.011–384.071 may be found guilty of a class B misdemeanor and fined up to $1,000. Refined scope.

headings.title: Remedies nonexclusive
headings.reviewNote: Read sub 4: states that the above penalties are not exclusive remedies.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently verified all 4 subsections and source notes (L. 1987 H.B. 700 § 21, A.L. 2007 S.B. 66). Confirmed subs 1 and 4, removed unsupported 'in circuit court' from sub 2, and refined sub 3 to match statutory violation scope.
